## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(rfPermute)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)


sym_chla <- read.csv("../Data/Nov_2024/oculina_nov24_physio.csv")
```

You can add options to executable code like this

re-creating Ella's scatter plot

```{r}
sym_chla_scatter <- ggplot(sym_chla, aes(x = sym_cm2, y = ug_chla_cm, fill = depth_sa)) +
  geom_point(color='black', shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white","lightyellow","brown"))+

  geom_smooth(aes(x = sym_cm2, y = ug_chla_cm, group = 1),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Symbiont density (cells per cm2)", 
       y = "Chlorophyll a (ug per cm2)", 
       fill = "Fragment symbiotic state")
sym_chla_scatter


#ug_chla_cm = micrograms of chlorophyll a per cm2 of surface area
#sym_cm2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

removing outliers from above scatter plot, including \[r-val?\]

```{r}

sym_chla_no_out <- sym_chla |>
  filter(sample_ID != "S26-S" & sample_ID != "S15-S")

sym_chla_scatter_no_out <- ggplot(sym_chla_no_out, aes(x = sym_cm2, y = ug_chla_cm, fill = depth_sa)) +
  geom_point(color='black', shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white","lightyellow","brown"))+

  geom_smooth(aes(x = sym_cm2, y = ug_chla_cm, group = 1),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Symbiont density (cells per cm2)", 
       y = "Chlorophyll a (ug per cm2)", 
       fill = "Fragment symbiotic state")
sym_chla_scatter_no_out
```

```{r}
chla_nov_depth_sa_box <- ggplot(sym_chla, aes(x = depth_sa, y=ug_chla_cm, fill = depth_sa))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.2,   # stay within each box
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width  = 1,     
    ), 
    
    shape = 21,               # fill + outline
    color = "black",          # outline
    stroke = 0.45,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 22)+
  
  labs(x = "Fragment symbiotic state", 
       y = "Chlorophyll a (ug per cm2)")+
  
  stat_summary(data = sym_chla, 
               aes(x = depth_sa, y = ug_chla_cm), 
               geom = "text", 
               fun = max, 
               vjust = -0.5, 
               size = 8,
               label = c("a", "a", "b")) + 
  
  
  
  #EDIT LETTERS FOR EACH GRAPH - MAKE SURE THEY MATCH WITH STATS!!
  #SAME LETTERS = SAME (not sig dif from eachother)
  #DIF LETTERS = SIGNFICANTLY DIFFERENT FROM EACHOTHER
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  ylim(-0.2,7)+ #ELLA - EDIT Y LIMIT IF IT CUTS OFF LETTERS ON THE TOP
  #MAKE SURE YOU DON'T GET THE WARNING THAT IT REMOVES ANY DATA (here, when I put Y=0, it got rid of a few)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("hotpink3","orange","blue")) #ella change the colors here as you'd like
chla_nov_depth_sa_box
```

sym_nov_depth_sa_box <- ggplot(sym_chla, aes(x = depth_sa, y=sym_cm2, fill = depth_sa))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.2,   # stay within each box
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width  = 1,     
    ), 
    
    shape = 21,               # fill + outline
    color = "black",          # outline
    stroke = 0.45,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 22)+
  
  labs(x = "Fragment symbiotic state", 
       y = "Symbiont density (# symbionts per cm2)")+

               geom = "text", 
               fun = max,
